evidence.text: Configured Zendesk for a 45-agent support team at Ledgerly: ticket forms, custom fields, agent groups and role permissions across three product lines.

Designed and rolled out 18 Zendesk triggers and automations that route tickets by product and plan tier and raise the priority of payroll-deadline issues, testing each one in the sandbox before switching it on.

Work sample: the change record for the payroll-deadline routing automation, with the trigger conditions, the sandbox test cases and their results, the switch-on date and the support director's approval.
Produced the weekly service-level report on first-response and full-resolution times by queue, sent to the head of support every Monday.
Helped the workforce planner gather ticket-volume history before the January peak.

missingEvidence: Direct evidence of planning staffing for seasonal peaks such as the end of the tax year
